items.source: Implementations perform the actual work of setting the actual values. They must implement the callback method setValue which can throw SQLExceptions that will be caught and translated by the calling code. This callback method has access to the underlying Connection via the given PreparedStatement object, if that should be needed to create any database-specific objects.
items.translation: 实现负责执行设置实际值的实际工作。它们必须实现回调方法 setValue，该方法可以抛出 SQLException，这些异常将被调用代码捕获并转换。如果需要使用给定的 PreparedStatement 对象来创建任何数据库特定的对象，则该回调方法可以通过该对象访问底层 Connection。

items.source: Clean up resources held by this value object.
items.translation: 清理此值对象持有的资源。

items.source: Set the value on the given PreparedStatement.
items.translation: 在指定的 PreparedStatement 上设置值。

items.source: SQLException - if an SQLException is encountered while setting parameter values
items.translation: SQLException - 如果在设置参数值时遇到 SQLException

items.source: paramIndex - the index of the parameter for which we need to set the value
items.translation: paramIndex - 需要设置其值的参数的索引
